care_team_notes: For non-English speakers, mention interpreter options early; use exact source instructions and avoid relying on family members for complex medical conversations when a professional interpreter is available.
description: Australian guidance on using TIS National, interpreter access in health services, emergency interpreting through Triple Zero and interpreter pathways for GP, hospital and other health appointments.
name: Interpreter access in healthcare
publisher: Healthdirect Australia / Australian Government Department of Health, Disability and Ageing

care_team_notes: Separate interpreter support from NDIS plan funding where the source says so; explain that interpreters interpret spoken words and do not provide NDIS advice.
description: NDIS participant and carer interpreter information, including TIS National, planner/partner interpreter booking, provider responsibilities, preferred interpreter continuity and NRS pathways for hearing or speech loss.
name: NDIS language interpreting services

care_team_notes: Use culturally safe wording, respect community-controlled pathways and do not assume all First Nations people want the same type of service or support.
description: NDIA First Nations Strategy information, including culturally safe access, Closing the Gap commitment, Auslan/language versions and implementation priorities for First Nations people with disability.
name: NDIS First Nations Strategy

care_team_notes: Remote community connectors are not clinicians; use them as an access/navigation pathway and direct health questions to GP, MND clinic or allied health teams.
description: NDIS remote community connector information for people in remote and very remote communities, including help to understand/apply for the NDIS, use supports, access services and connect with translators or health professionals.
name: Remote community connectors

care_team_notes: Useful where a person is not eligible for NDIS, is waiting for access, is aged outside a pathway or needs local/community supports alongside formal services.
description: NDIS community connections information for people with disability to find mainstream, local, peer, inclusive employment, community and early connections support, including remote access notes.
name: Community connections

care_team_notes: For rural users, ask about nearest hospital, GP, telehealth access, travel assistance, local pharmacy, MND association coverage and backup plans for urgent changes.
description: Healthdirect guidance for rural and remote health access, telehealth, travel/accommodation support, local services, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander health services and online/telephone support.
name: Rural and remote health access

care_team_notes: Use as a directory source, not a personal referral; encourage confirmation of availability, accessibility, fees, home visits and telehealth directly with the service.
description: National health service directory for finding doctors, pharmacies, hospitals and other health services, including local options that may matter for rural/regional planning.
name: Healthdirect Service Finder

care_team_notes: For MND speech change, combine NRS information with Topic 8 communication/AAC resources and Topic 15 emergency communication planning.
description: Source-linked access pathways for people who are d/Deaf, hard of hearing, or have speech/communication difficulty, including NRS support for healthdirect and NDIS contacts.
name: National Relay Service and speech/hearing access

care_team_notes: Use for system-context and translated-resource discovery; do not imply individual entitlement without checking the relevant NDIS access/planning source.
description: NDIS Cultural and Linguistic Diversity Strategy and Action Plan information, translated resources and policy context for improving NDIS access and plan use for CALD participants.
name: NDIS CALD Strategy and Action Plan
